findings.fix: First strengthen `UniversalCover.discreteTopology_fiber` to remove `[PathConnectedSpace X]`, then state the roadmap theorem with only `[LocallyPathConnectedSpace X] [SemilocallySimplyConnectedSpace X]`.

summary: Milestone 1 is discharged only after adding a global path-connectedness assumption absent from the roadmap, so the archived target is strictly weaker than required.
